compression.factor_orientation: U:[out,rank] V:[rank,in]; W = diag(u1) U diag(u2*v1) V diag(v2)
compression.forward_order: ((((x*v2) @ V^T) * (v1*u2)) @ U^T) * u1, residual path added, then bias
compression.padding: rows padded to 32 columns with +1 (bit 0); padding bits must be 0

capabilities.notes: tool_calling is not validated; requests with tools are rejected
